followup_reviews.Separate challenger: GPT-6 Astra Pro /root/verification_recovery, separate same-model context
followup_reviews.Research finding: The nationwide election order and a separate local Rumichaca closure/reopening are supported. Both phases remain included with distinct evidence categories. The order covers authorised land and river traveller movements, with fortuitous-event/force-majeure exceptions. The operational phase covers Rumichaca ordinary travellers only. Country labels do not establish an authorised gate on every frontier. AM047-R1 schedules 30 May 18:00–1 June 06:00, 36 hours. AM047-C6OP1 has a retrospective report of actual 1 June reopening after 36 hours. Its two-day date difference is not an elapsed 48-hour duration. Correct only the contradictory Unknown observed-reopening flag to Yes. Electoral administration/security and public-order safety are explicitly stated in the official notice. Tariff removal discussed in the reopening article is a separate policy and not recoded as the election closure’s rationale. The local reopening passage was directly read. Official order and decree article 26 were available as indexed text after portal failures and a timeout; alternate official paths are the same origin, not independent corroboration. Both phases remain unlocated, with announcement and scoped-operational temporal rules respectively. No extrapolation of Rumichaca’s actual reopening to all Colombian frontiers is proposed.
followup_reviews.Challenge verdict: Accepted within the root decision; see frozen challenge
followup_reviews.Challenge finding: Challenge packet SHA-256: 75f71973a192fafd898d69eee3f642a94b186f28c8ab91f32c95fb2d2560df1a. Per-question challenge findings remain in that packet.
followup_reviews.Root decision: Accept the full fixed sample audit of 16 parents and 27 phases, including 29 guarded input-cell corrections and the new Sadao onset question. Withdraw the unsupported Beitbridge cargo endpoint and exact Sadao duration, retain the Benapole quarantine, recognise the observed Rumichaca reopening and append the accessible Korala report. Apply the challenger’s medical-visa cohort, shared-reporting inference and unread-translation metadata refinements. Unknown dates, continuity, exceptions, missing source access and geographic limits remain explicit. This is a completed audit procedure for the sample, not a certification that all attributes are known or that the full register has been freshly verified.
